description: Functions and classes for working with 3DEC histories.

functions.name: get
functions.signature: itasca.history.get(name1: string, name2="step": string) -> Numpy array
functions.description: Get a nested numpy array with values of histroies \(name1\) vs \(name2\). (\(name2\) default ‘step’). On 3DEC 9.8.54 a name2 that is not a history name (e.g. 'time') silently falls back to step: to plot against time, create one first ('model history name 't' mechanical time-total') and pass 't'.

notes: The engine's own module docstring says 'FLAC3d histories'; the history module is shared by the Itasca 9 kernel and behaves the same in 3DEC.
